billingOps.settleSuccess: Order {orderId} settled. The event is now active.
billingOps.webhooksSubtitle: Deliveries received but never processed — settlements the platform may have lost.
billingOps.webhooksEmpty: Nothing unprocessed. Every delivery has been handled.
billingOps.notReplayable: This delivery predates body storage and cannot be replayed.
billingOps.confirmReplayBody: This asks the backend to process the stored provider delivery again. Use it only after checking the delivery is safe to retry.
billingOps.confirmSettleBody: This marks the order paid without a provider payment and can activate the event. Confirm only after verifying the payment or comp.
billingOps.confirmSweepBody: This can create visible host notifications for quota warnings, offers, and tips. It cannot send arbitrary messages.
billingOps.orderIdSourceHint: Copy the order ID from an unprocessed webhook below, or from the refund request for the same event — the console has no order search.
billingOps.orderIdInvalid: That is not a valid order ID. It should look like 3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6.

refunds.title: Refund requests
refunds.subtitle: Approving refunds the payment, returns the event to draft, and takes it offline. Decide from the usage below rather than from the reason alone.
refunds.emptyPending: Nothing pending. Every request has been decided.
refunds.notEligible: No longer meets the refund conditions
refunds.rejectStillAvailable: Approval is blocked, but you can still reject with a note explaining why.
refunds.notRefundedByProvider: Approved, but the provider did not return the money. Refund it manually.
refunds.noteHint: This note is sent to the host.
refunds.noteRequiredHint: A rejection needs a note — the host is told only what you write here.
refunds.confirmApprove: This refunds the payment and returns the event to draft, taking it offline. Continue?
refunds.confirmReject: The host will be told this request was rejected. Continue?

lifecycle.title: Event lifecycle
lifecycle.subtitle: Freeze and purge both act on the event named below. Enter it once, then choose the action.
lifecycle.idSourceHint: Copy the event ID from a refund request, or ask the host for the link to their event — the console has no event search.
lifecycle.idInvalid: That is not a valid event ID. It should look like 3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6.
lifecycle.purgeUnverified: This ID did not come from a console row, so nothing here confirms which event it is. Check it before purging.
lifecycle.freezeSubtitle: Makes the event read-only. Guests can still view it; nobody can post.
lifecycle.purgeWarning: This permanently deletes every file stored for the event. It cannot be undone.
lifecycle.purgeConfirmField: Type the event ID again to confirm
lifecycle.purgePartial: Some files for {eventId} could not be deleted. The event stays frozen — run purge again.
lifecycle.freezeConfirmBody: The event will become read-only while lifecycle handling runs. Hosts and guests will not be able to make changes.
lifecycle.purgeConfirmBody: This deletes event data and files wherever possible. Do not continue unless the final checks are complete.
